title: Backend Engineer - AI Platform
responsibilities: Design and develop backend services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI.
Design data models and build reliable database integrations using PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
Develop and integrate LLM-powered features into backend applications.
Build retrieval and AI-agent workflows for production applications.
Deploy and maintain backend services using cloud infrastructure.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested production code.
Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design decisions.
Collaborate with product, frontend, AI, and infrastructure engineering teams.
description: We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our AI Platform Engineering team. The engineer will build production backend systems and APIs supporting AI-powered applications. The role involves Python backend development, database engineering, cloud deployment, and integration of LLM and retrieval-based systems. Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, vector databases, or related AI application frameworks is highly desirable.
